name: manual_fea349
claim: A global npm install lands in the prefix of whichever node comes first on PATH, even when run through another node's npm path: set PATH explicitly for the install and print npm -g config get prefix in the same command, or the package lands under the wrong node and the intended copy stays stale.
conditions: npm global prefix path node nvm install wrong

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26: an install of claude-code latest created a duplicate under node 22 while the default node 24.22.3 copy stayed at an older version; the duplicate was removed with that node's own npm and a second install with explicit PATH updated the right copy.
